definitions.explanation: Describes something happening one after another without pause or interruption. Emphasizes the relentless, unbroken nature of an activity or occurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひっきりなしに⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。

examples.english: Customers come to that shop one after another without end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひっきりなしに⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大忙|おおいそが}しだった。
examples.english: At year-end, reservations for year-end parties came in nonstop, and the restaurant was extremely busy.

notes:
Derived from {引|ひ}っ{切|き}り⟦{無|な}し→無し：03779_nashi⟧ (without a cut/break). The word suggests a stream of events with no gap between them. Very natural in spoken and written Japanese.

USAGE:
Most commonly used with verbs of motion, arrival, or occurrence — things coming and going, calls arriving, visitors appearing, etc. Less commonly used for a single continuous action; instead it implies repeated discrete events happening in rapid succession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひっきりなしに⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come one after another
- ひっきりなしに⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: to ring nonstop
- ひっきりなしに⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue without letup
- ひっきりなしに⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧: to visit incessantly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく: without interruption — more literary
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: one after another — emphasizes sequence
- しきり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: frequently, repeatedly — implies high frequency but allows gaps
